method: Visual inspection of all five generated images, final exports and contact-sheet concepts at 180 px plus exact 60 px previews on dark and light backgrounds.
strongest_pick_reason: The warm glowing entrance separates strongly from the deep-green Home Screen background and directs attention to the visible reception desk and computer.
postprocessing_decisions: Preserved generated RGB colors after a trial median-cut palette dulled the small blue cooler.
Selected a 256 px native grid, enlarged 4x with nearest-neighbor, to preserve outlines and clock hands in these detailed storefronts.
Flattened only edge-connected background and removed ten detached background speck pixels in R3-04; content fits within the central approximately 80%.
Exported actual 60 px nearest-neighbor previews and reviewed both contact-sheet rows.

variants.note: Straight-on awning and paired low flower beds frame the open door. The warm room, teal counter and dark monitor read clearly at 60 px.
The close straight-on entrance gives the desk the most width. The open wood door, large clock and blue cooler remain recognizable.
The slight left-angle return and striped awning communicate a whole small storefront. Golden cream and paired flower beds match the game's frontage materials.
Strongest pick: golden doorway against deep green gives a clear focal point. The open door, desk, monitor, wall clock, blue cooler and plant stay visible.
The slight right-angle entrance offers an alternate silhouette. Wood door, cream wall, blue cooler and one low flower bed make a colorful teal-background option.
